title: 2013 AMC 8 Problem 22
statement: Toothpicks are used to make a grid that is \(60\) toothpicks long and \(32\) toothpicks high. How many toothpicks are used altogether?

solutions.text:
A \(60\)-by-\(32\) grid has \(61\) vertical grid lines, each made of \(32\) toothpicks, and \(33\) horizontal grid lines, each made of \(60\) toothpicks.

Therefore the total number of toothpicks is \[ \begin{aligned} 61\cdot32+33\cdot60 &= 1952+1980 \\ &= 3932. \end{aligned} \]

Thus, E is the correct answer.
hints: Count vertical and horizontal toothpicks separately.
A \(60\) by \(32\) grid has \(61\) vertical lines and \(33\) horizontal lines.
